audit_result.proof_trace: The middleware at src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts:51 blanket-exempts all /api/* routes from auth enforcement; API routes must self-protect. Three of four API routes call getUser() and return 401 on failure, but GET /api/auth/debug (marked temporary in its own header comment) has no authentication check at all and returns session state, Supabase auth cookie names, and forwarded host/proto headers to any caller.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated attacker sends GET /api/auth/debug; the middleware passes the request through (isPublicPath = true for /api), and the handler returns cookie metadata including Supabase token cookie names and x-forwarded-host/proto headers with no credentials required.

PROP-stem-system-pre-007.text: Protected routes must require authenticated session via middleware; unauthenticated users redirect to /login.
PROP-stem-system-pre-007.assertion: forall req: protected_route(req) => pre(supabase.auth.getUser() != null) OR redirect('/login')
